about: The decision table for the Slack pack: each operation served, the demand or life step or refresh that brings it in (journeys/demand.json, journeys/customer-life.json, the manifest's refresh scopes), and its mechanism. Admin API, SCIM and legacy OAuth are outside it; an operation no demand, life step or refresh reaches answers the gap.

decisions.why: Resolve the caller grant to its workspace/person/bot; authentication errors precede the identity answer.

decisions.demand: the life: at the handover a stray notification shows Runhuman is still connected, and Maya disconnects Slack in Runhuman, whose server revokes its grant (June 2028)
decisions.why: Revoke the presented grant and subsequent access; Runhuman's server disconnects this way.

decisions.demand: demand: RH2 (rhh worker, channel bridge), Dub, Postiz
decisions.why: Exchange one pending consent code; validate the app secret, matching redirect, lifetime and single use, and retain only the scopes the ordinary workspace consent granted.
Validate the published manifest shape and return errors without creating an app.
Create an app from a valid manifest owned by the configuration-token holder, issuing credentials as secrets.
Update the holder-owned app configuration; installed grants keep their granted scopes.
Read the holder-owned app manifest for editing.
Remove a holder-owned app and revoke its installations.

decisions.demand: demand: Dub (the integration removed, with the token and client credentials)
decisions.why: Uninstall the caller app in its workspace and revoke its grants, with app-uninstalled and token-revoked deliveries.
Allocate a Socket Mode connection for the app-level grant; the kernel owns the socket session.

decisions.demand: demand: RH2, Volter Harness (text and markdown_text in a thread), Twin's on-call recipe, Postiz
decisions.why: Authorize channel membership and granted scope; append the timestamped message/thread reply and send subscribed message events.
Authorize ownership of the timestamped message; update its content and emit the changed-message event used by RH2 status replies.
Authorize ownership and delete the timestamped message, emitting its deletion.
Compute the published Slack message URL from workspace, channel and message timestamp.
Append the documented action-message subtype with the caller as author.
Store a future message after the documented schedule window/queue checks; the clock sends it at post_at.
List the caller visible unsent scheduled messages with paging.
Remove the caller unsent scheduled message; refuse one already delivered or missing.

decisions.demand: demand: RH2 (a note to the person alone in the thread)
decisions.why: Record the private delivery only for the addressed workspace member; RH2 uses this for thread refusals.
Update a shared link with the app unfurl content after grant and channel checks.
Create a workspace channel and the caller membership, with valid unique channel-name checks.
Project one channel as visible to the caller workspace and membership; RH2 channel bridge checks it.
Join a public unarchived channel and emit member_joined_channel; RH2 retries posting after not_in_channel.
Add accessible workspace members to a channel, refusing a missing member, private denial or archived channel.
Remove the caller channel membership, refusing the documented ineligible channel.
List channel membership subject ids, with caller visibility and paging.

decisions.demand: demand: Twin's on-call recipe, Postiz (types=public_channel,private_channel); the channel refresh reads it
decisions.why: List caller-visible public/private/IM channels, filtering archived/types and retaining cursor paging used by Runhuman.

decisions.demand: demand: Twin's on-call recipe; the message refresh reads it
decisions.why: Read visible messages with oldest/latest boundaries and cursor paging.
Read the visible parent and its replies using thread timestamps.
Resolve or create the caller direct-message conversation for its user set.
Move is_archived false to true; refuse already_archived; subsequent posting fails channel_is_archived.
Move is_archived true to false; refuse not_archived; preserve messages and membership.
Rename the visible channel with actor, naming and duplicate checks.
Set the channel purpose after membership/actor checks.
Set the channel topic after membership/actor checks.
Record the caller last-read marker for the visible conversation.

decisions.demand: demand: RH2's channel bridge, Volter Harness (a message's author), Postiz (the bot's user)
decisions.why: Read one visible workspace member with the fields the granted scopes permit.

decisions.demand: the user and team_member refreshes read it
decisions.why: List workspace members with cursor paging and scope-controlled email/profile fields.

decisions.demand: demand: Dub (the person who ran /shorten, by profile email)
decisions.why: Read the permitted member profile.
Update the caller profile, preserving fields outside the request.
List conversations the selected accessible member belongs to.
Read member presence within the caller workspace.
Set the caller presence to the documented auto/away choice.
Create a workspace user group, checking actor and handle uniqueness.

decisions.demand: the usergroup and usergroup_channel refreshes read it
decisions.why: List workspace user groups including disabled groups only when requested.
Update a workspace group metadata; refuse absent group or duplicate handle.
List workspace group members.
Replace workspace group membership with accessible users.
Disable a workspace group and stop its use in mentions.
Enable a disabled workspace group; keep membership.
Reserve an upload with its declared filename/length and issue a secret upload URL.

decisions.demand: demand: Volter Harness (files.uploadV2, into a thread)
decisions.why: Publish only uploaded file bytes, associate the selected visible channel and emit its file event.
Read completed files visible to the caller in its workspace; an app sees shared files only in conversations its bot joined, and an uploader retains access to its own private upload.
Remove a caller-owned file and its blob after authorization.
Add the visible channel message to its pins; refuse an already pinned or missing message.
Remove an existing channel-message pin.
Read the channel pins and their visible message projections.
Add the caller reaction to the visible message once, emitting reaction_added.
Remove that caller reaction, emitting reaction_removed.
Read a visible message with its reactions grouped by emoji.

decisions.demand: the life; the team refresh reads it
decisions.why: Read the caller workspace identity; a selected team must be accessible.
Publish a Home view for the accessible member from the app grant, checking the supplied view/hash.
Set the caller timed snooze interval; the clock determines when it expires.
End the caller active snooze and return its current status.

decisions.demand: the life; the emoji refresh reads it
decisions.why: Read workspace custom emoji aliases and images.
Rotate the holder app-configuration token pair through the documented app-manifest tooling flow.

decisions.why: State an externally developed distributed app whose own creation occurred outside this World; does not impersonate a stored Web API mutation.

decisions.demand: the life: a client act or an outside app the story needs

decisions.why: Observe invitations sent to a person inbox; workspace membership still happens through the Join page.

decisions.demand: the World credential issuer and official SDK cases
decisions.why: Issue the installed World app credentials through the existing settings door; API mutations still use Slack APIs.

Store a recipient-specific outgoing Slack Connect invitation and its channel, author and creation time. Refuse archived/general/DM channels, a caller outside the channel, malformed recipients and multiple recipients. Return the documented invite id without a shareable URL; receiving workspace acceptance and approval remain outside this demand.

decisions.demand: refresh of pending Slack Connect invitations and customer-life readback
decisions.why: Read the stored outgoing invitations for the caller workspace with count/cursor pagination and nested invite identity. Pending-only refresh is incomplete for historical accepted or expired invitations.
